name: B10-0277/2025 – After § 16 – Am 26
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 16b. Reiterates that European competitiveness stems from relatively high social standards, long-term sustainability investments and considerable public involvement in education, sanitation, infrastructure and care; underlines that the Public Procurement Directive should be adequately adapted to these circumstances to ensure continued European competitiveness and an industry sector in which social and sustainability conditions are met when public support and investment are received;
